summary: One rigid-body integration step on the vehicle physics tick. Advances linear position (this+4/+12/+20) with an a2-scaled velocity Euler step, staging copies of each previous state block (this+356, this+380, this+452, this+476, this+500, this+524), advances linear velocity (this+100/+108/+116) using the a2-scaled velocity factor this+180, scales the angular momentum into a vector, passes it to sub_56C020, advances angular momentum (this+148/+156/+164), runs F_3x3InertiaTensorTransform, and writes the inertia-transformed result back to angular velocity (this+124/+132/+140). Returns the integer result of the inertia transform.

local_names.this: vehicle physics rigid-body node whose state is integrated
local_names.a2: frame delta used as the Euler step scale
local_names.v6: a2-scaled linear velocity factor applied to all three axes
local_names.v11: a2-scaled angular momentum vector passed to sub_56C020
local_names.result: integer return value of F_3x3InertiaTensorTransform, returned as-is
